song.name: Beyond Horizon
song.plot: Acheron journeys to the subterranean abyss of Nythoria and discards the Forbidden Tome into the ancient ruins (~100 BGD). He believes it is safely lost forever, directly setting up the start of *Vows of Silence* where Malakar finds it.
song.analysis: Acheron discards the Forbidden Tome in Nythoria's ancient ruins (~100 BGD), believing he has saved the light — direct setup for Malakar in *Vows of Silence*. User-approved rework: mirrors the original per-line syllable counts (V1 9-11-8-8, Chorus 10-10-9-8, V2 9-9-10-9, Bridge 10-9-9-10, V3 11-9-9-8, V4 11-9-14-9, Outro 4-5) AND the original chorus rhythmic shape (comma breaks, stress positions, rhyme anchors "unfolds/holds, fight/light"; only "story"→"legend", "blood"→"doom" changed). Original Kael content (wrong era, ~300 AGD) replaced with Acheron's Tome disposal; bridge sets up Malakar. Suno box respellings: Nih-tho-ria, Ah-ke-ron, Ma-la-kar (release lyrics keep standard spelling). Suggested song direction: epic, transitional, monumental — dark cinematic orchestral, deep percussion, rising strings, ominous choir swells, wide anthemic chorus, bridge dropping low and uneasy, outro fading to vast silence.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: The world reshaped, beneath a scarred sky In the shadow of the past, where secrets lie A bloodline stained, an heir in chains Kael stands alone, where darkness reigns
section.reworked: To deep Nythoria's sunless floor He carries the dark book to the world below To bury the Forbidden Tome Far from his Eldorian home

section.name: Chorus
section.original: Beyond Horizon, a story unfolds A legacy of blood, a fate that holds The curse still lingers, a restless fight To break the chains and find the light
